_note: What you see: The parent reports a care concern to the confidential adviser and chooses whether she wants a conversation.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De ouder meldt een zorg bij de vertrouwenspersoon en kiest of ze een gesprek wil.
Aanvragen kan tot vrijdag 16 oktober. U: Requests are open until vrijdag 16 oktober. You choose the teachers, the school schedules the times.
Vakken kiezen voor havo 4, schooljaar 20: Choose subjects for havo 4, school year 2027-2028
Fenna is jonger dan 18. Haar keuze gaat: Fenna is under 18. Her choice only goes through with a parent's consent.
Mentoruur, 7e uur, in een ander lokaal: Mentor hour, period 7, in another room
Cijfers, huiswerk, aanwezigheid en ziekm: Fenna's grades, homework, attendance and reporting sick are in the parent portal of Zuiddrecht College.
Uw melding gaat naar de vertrouwensperso: Your report goes to the school's confidential adviser. Only the confidential adviser and you can read it. The mentor does not see it.
Fenna vertelt thuis dat een groepje uit: Fenna says at home that a group from 3HV-A has been calling her names in the group chat for a few weeks. She does not dare to report it herself.
Vertel wat er gebeurde, waar en wie erbi: Tell what happened, where and who was there if you want to. The confidential adviser reads your own words.
De vertrouwenspersoon neemt contact met: The confidential adviser contacts you. Remove the tick if you only want to let them know.
Na het versturen ziet u of uw melding is: After sending you see whether your report is received, in progress or closed.
